title: Root tip regeneration: Yet another feather in FERONIA's cap
content: It is hard to escape the impression that FERONIA (FER) is everywhere. Loss of this receptor-like kinase leads to astonishingly diverse effects, including in pollen tube growth, cell shape, root architecture, abiotic and biotic stress resistance, and flowering time. Synthesizing the available evidence, Malivert and Hamant (2023) proposed a disturbed balance between cell wall integrity and turgor pressure as a unifying feature of these phenotypes, although it is not clear whether FER acts primarily in perception, wall responses, or regulation of water uptake (Malivert and Hamant 2023).
